proves.claim: a fact that also lifts an infra hold returns and consumes its own fact row, not the chained unhold_item row.

store.io-board-write-sequencer.exact-tri.why: Without this test, a regression where trigger consumers read board.lastEvent, which ends as the chained unhold_item row, would pass unnoticed.
